name: On-Time Delivery %
description: Share of eligible customer orders delivered on or before the promised delivery date. An order counts as delivered only when its final leg arrives.
definition_sql: 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / sum(CASE WHEN is_eligible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

personal_data_fields.note: Party key, not a name. Resolves to a legal entity in SAP KNA1; for named-individual sole proprietors it is personal data under DPDP.
City-level only. No street address is carried into the mart.

processing_purpose: Supply chain performance measurement and delivery-commitment management
retention_basis: Statutory commercial record-keeping period; delivery performance is contract-performance evidence.
masking_policy: customer_id pseudonymised at ingestion; ship_to_city truncated to city; no masking applied to aggregate metric output
lineage: SAP PP (PLAF/AFKO/AFRU) — planned order, production order, confirmation
SAP QM (QALS) — inspection lot and usage decision
SAP MM/EWM (MSEG/MKPF) — goods issue to production, goods receipt to stock, picking
SAP TM/LE-SHP (LIKP/VTTK) — actual goods issue, shipment, proof of delivery
sql/02_staging_model.sql — staging views, canonical names and types
fact_order_delivery — order-grain mart, delivery legs collapsed
semantic layer — validated intent compiled to SQL

quality_contract.badge_semantics: TRUSTED = all rules pass. DEGRADED = a degrading rule fails; the number is served with the failing rule named. BLOCKED = a blocking rule fails; a refusal is returned instead of a number.

known_limitations: Measured against the CURRENT promised date, not the original. Re-promised orders (SO-1011) are judged on the commitment in force at delivery, which flatters performance where re-promising is routine.
Order grain only. Delivery-grain aggregation returns 88.52% instead of 87.27% on this dataset by double-counting split shipments.
Make-to-stock orders (SO-1015) have no production order, so manufacturing phase attribution is legitimately absent for them rather than zero.
A single order-grain fact table. Multi-fact conformed-dimension queries are out of scope for this reference implementation.
governance_note: These fields make personal data discoverable and support India DPDP readiness work — data-subject categories, processing purpose, legal basis, retention, and declared masking. This catalog entry DOES NOT ENFORCE any of them. It is not a substitute for enforcement: access control, consent management, retention automation, and masking all live in the platform layer, and a field declared here is a statement of intent until a control implements it. Treat a populated governance block as a discovery aid and an audit trail of decisions, never as evidence that a control is operating.
as_of_note: certified_on carries the __AS_OF_DATE__ token rather than a literal date. src/semantic/constants.py is the single home of the as-of date; substituting it at read time is what stops this artifact from silently expiring.
